director.title: Director
director.help: The Tutorial Director reads the recording — the words you said and the clicks it recorded — and proposes scenes, cuts, zooms, callouts and title cards. Nothing changes the video until you approve it. What was observed and what is inferred are always marked apart.
director.intro: Analyse the recording to get a storyboard: scenes, what was observed in each, and suggested edits to review.
director.enrich: Ask the AI model for scene titles
director.enrichHint: Sends the transcribed words and click counts of each scene to the configured provider. No video, screenshots or files are sent.
director.noFootage: Add a recording to the timeline first.
director.noScenes: No scenes found: the timeline has no footage.
director.stale: The timeline changed since this analysis. Analyse again to refresh the suggestions.
director.clearConfirm: Remove the storyboard from this project? Edits already applied stay.
director.applyFailed: {{count}} suggestions were refused; each one says why

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.help: The Privacy Guardian reads the text shown in your recording (locally, with OCR over sampled frames) and the transcript, and flags what looks sensitive: keys, tokens, emails, card numbers and the like. Findings are shown masked. Accepting one blurs it on the video through the same tools every edit uses. Nothing is sent anywhere.
privacy.intro: Scan the recordings on the timeline for sensitive text, then blur or dismiss each finding before exporting.
privacy.scanStopped: The scan was stopped; findings so far were kept.
privacy.noFootage: Add a recording to the timeline first.
privacy.noFfmpeg: ffmpeg is missing in this install, so frames cannot be read; only the transcript is scanned.
privacy.noOcr: Text recognition is not available in this build; only the transcript is scanned.
privacy.modelReady: Text recognition runs on this computer. The recognition model is installed.
privacy.modelDownload: Text recognition runs on this computer. The first scan downloads the English recognition model (about 5 MB) once.
privacy.nothingFound: Nothing sensitive was found in the sampled frames or the transcript. A scan samples the recording; it cannot promise there is nothing in between.
privacy.seenOnScreen: On screen in {{count}} frames, first at {{time}}
privacy.spokenAt: Spoken at {{time}}; cut it from the transcript if needed
privacy.blurFailed: {{count}} findings could not be blurred; each one says why
